title: Graph Structured Neural Networks for Perturbation Biology
note: Edge-valued state: each Reactome-restricted OmniPath protein or RNA node is a private MLP that reads its in-edges and writes one value per out-edge, unrolled 10-20 residual steps over a cyclic graph with sparse index-list weights (PyG scatter-add); per-sample Gumbel edge-mask explainer; code_ref is tag v1.0.0, which the README names for the preprint.

title: An interpretable survival model for diffuse large B-cell lymphoma patients using a biologically informed visible neural network
note: BioVNN-derived: each Reactome pathway with >= 5 input genes (propagated gene sets) is its own dense layer of max(10, in-degree) units reading all its member gene columns and child pathways' units, run child-before-parent to an added root whose units join 3 raw clinical columns in a dense Cox head; SHAP code is not in the repo.

title: A deep learning model of tumor cell architecture elucidates response and resistance to CDK4/6 inhibitors
note: DrugCell-lineage VNN on 131 NeST assemblies layered by height: each gene is one unit fed by its 3 binary flags, each assembly is its own Linear (k units) over child units plus per-edge scalar copies of its direct genes (full 718-wide weight masked at init and in the gradient), with an auxiliary head per assembly; assemblies scored by a PCA-plus-ridge probe on their units (RLIPP variant).

title: Using DeepSignalingFlow to mine signaling flows interpreting mechanism of synergy of cocktails
note: Bidirectional message passing over KEGG signaling plus DrugBank drug-target graph (gene and drug nodes, 4 channels per gene): one trainable scalar per gene-gene edge per layer and direction on shared channel transforms, drug edges fixed at 1; bilinear head on the two drug nodes; edge weights averaged into signaling-flow scores.

title: DTox: A deep neural network-based in visio lens for large scale toxicogenomics data
note: out-of-scope: a ResNet-18 image classifier on 3D surface plots of each probe's expression over dose and time, explained with XGrad-CAM; no pathway, ontology, or gene-network prior shapes the network (checked the J-STAGE full text and the GitHub README). Not the pathway-based DTox of Hao et al.

title: DeepKEGG: a multi-omics data integration framework with biological insights for cancer recurrence prediction and biomarker discovery
note: One KEGG feature-to-pathway layer per omics (SNV, mRNA, miRNA; 238 pathways in both gene and miRNA sets) as per-edge weight vectors scattered into dense kernels, then per-branch attention across the batch and a dense head; gradient-times-input feature scores summed over recurrence samples.

title: PathExpSurv: pathway expansion for explainable survival analysis and disease gene discovery
note: One gene-to-pathway layer from hand-picked KEGG disease pathways as two full matrices with complementary masks, clamped to >= 0 and re-zeroed in place; phase 2 switches on all non-prior pairs with an L1 penalty; edge selection counts over 100 resampled runs give expanded pathways.

title: MOViDA: multiomics visible drug activity prediction with a biologically informed neural network model
note: DrugCell-style GO BP VNN (2086 terms, 6 units each, computed leaves first) fed by separate mutation, amplification, and deletion gene tables plus one expression enrichment score per term, joined with a dense drug branch; gene-to-term masks hold only at initialization because the gradient mask never matches a parameter; RIS and DeepLIFT code not released.

title: PiDeeL: metabolic pathway-informed deep learning model for survival analysis and pathological classification of gliomas
note: One masked dense layer, 37 metabolites to 138 KEGG pathways (fixed 0/1 matrix times the weight in each forward pass), then a dense head; random-mask and row-shuffle controls; SHAP in the paper but not in the code; the two shipped membership tables differ (472 vs 468 edges).

title: PINNet: a deep neural network with pathway prior knowledge for Alzheimer's disease
note: KEGG or GO BP gene-to-pathway 0/1 mask on one linear layer, one unit per pathway divided by the square root of its gene count, beside a dense branch over all genes and concatenated into a dense head; the mask is applied by replacing the weight with a new parameter each forward, so the masked weights are not in the optimizer; Deep SHAP is in the paper only.

title: Reliable interpretability of biology-inspired deep neural networks
framework: R 4.3.1 analysis; runs P-NET (Keras/TensorFlow 1) and DTox (PyTorch)
note: No model of its own: patches seeds into P-NET at 2b16264 (same commit as pnet-2021) and DTox at 10c909b, retrains each 51 times, adds deterministic-input and shuffled-label controls, correlates node scores with centrality, and corrects them by quantile-normalized original minus control; DTox has per-node Linear modules sized by gene-set size, gathered by child index, scored by LRP.
